findings.title: The yield instrument's verdict population is not the review rounds the verdict bus records: 42 rounds missing, 9 counted twice
findings.claim: Over the 234 merges of v7.1.10..92d38ecb, policy_lint.mjs --stats (fetchWindow + statsHistogram, comments and reviews) reads 420 verdict comments, while the verdict bus holds 452 distinct (PR, word, head) verdicts: 42 bus verdicts (24 blocked, over 32 PRs, every head an ancestor of the merged branch) never reached the PR as a comment or review, and 9 comments are second relays of one verdict (same bus-nonce), so rounds per merge reads 2.039 where the bus population read once gives 2.178, one-round yield 0.476 where it gives 0.452, and #3618 (a fix lane with a bus merge verdict) reads as a merge carrying no verdict.
findings.mechanism: A reviewer's verdict is written to the bus (review/<pr>, verdict/<pr>, archived as archive/review/<pr>) and relayed to the PR as an hpo-approver comment; the relay delivered some verdicts never (42, including a cluster written to the bus 2026-11-14 10:45-11:45) and some twice (9, identical bus-nonce, hours apart). fetchWindow reads only /issues/<n>/comments and /pulls/<n>/reviews, and statsHistogram counts every parsable comment as one round; review_strength.py reads the bus. The two in-tree verdict readers therefore count different populations of the same rounds, and the brief's rule (comment or review) inherits the comment side's gaps.

evidence.value: bus_only_verdicts=42 (24 blocked, 32 PRs, 42/42 heads on the merged branch); relay_duplicates=9 (8 PRs); rounds_mean 2.039 -> 2.178; one_round_yield 0.476 -> 0.452; verdict_prs 206 -> 208

findings.title: 47.8% of blocked verdicts carry a class word VERDICT_CLASSES lacks; bus.sh and fixer.md teach a second vocabulary
findings.claim: Over the 569 merged pull requests first-parent in v7.1.0..92d38ecb, 214 of the 448 parseable blocked verdicts (0.478; 93 distinct words, on 155 PRs) carry a class word that web-fix-wave.js's VERDICT_CLASSES does not hold, so parseVerdict routes every one to `other` and no bucket can be read off the grammar for them; 71 of them (ci-red 63, ci-cancelled 4, ci-pending 2, red-unanswered 1, body 1) are words that bus.sh's MECHANICAL_CLASSES and fixer.md's 'Never for a mechanical-only gap' paragraph teach, 9 of bus.sh's 12 mechanical words being absent from VERDICT_CLASSES.
findings.mechanism: Two writers of the block vocabulary and one reader: VERDICT_CLASSES (web-fix-wave.js, read by policy_lint.mjs:blockClasses and the wave's parseVerdict) and MECHANICAL_CLASSES (tools/audit/seat/bus.sh:672, taught by dev/governance/roles/fixer.md:311), while fix-review.md teaches the class as free `[a-z-]+`. check-wave-script.mjs's taught-word check reads only `blocked <sha> <word>:` examples in briefs, so fixer.md's prose list and bus.sh's shell variable never meet it. findings.claim: On the owner's 2026-11-16 download, tools/replay/debug_replay.py:run_seeded seeds store documents whose entity-id leaves (8 leaves in 4 stores) name ids absent from the masked replay half, so the replayed coordinator voids house_heat_loss_scale and lower_floor_loss_ratio ('its zone sensor changed') and drops 42 learned heat-loss samples before its first cycle: the D15 timeline replay runs a house model the install does not have.
findings.mechanism: The debugger bundle's replay half is written through replay_doc's mask (each configured entity becomes its role name or an e_<hash> id), while its stores section is the install's store documents verbatim. debug_replay.seed_stores writes those documents onto the stub disk unchanged; the coordinator's thermal-learning load compares the stored heat_loss_zone_entities with the replay entry's (masked) zone sensors, finds them different, and runs the one void path (_void_heat_loss_learners). The same mismatch leaves dhw_legionella.disinfection_owned and off_restore.armed naming ids the replay has no state for (the replay logs the owned disinfection switch as unreadable).

evidence.contention_note: box shared with other finder seats (two other debug_replay runs); counts are contention-immune

findings.title: debug_replay starts the window from download-time stores: 142 of 192 accuracy samples postdate the replay clock
findings.claim: On the owner's 2026-11-16 download, debug_replay.run_seeded starts the replay window with a coordinator whose accuracy tracker holds 142 of its 192 samples stamped after the replay's own first-cycle clock (up to 41.4 h ahead), and 10 further stored instants are bounded as 'ahead of the clock', because the stores are the download's (19.5 h after the collection ended) seeded as the state at the window's start.
findings.mechanism: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/debugger.py reads the stores at download time; the replay half covers the collection's last day. tools/replay/debug_replay.py:seed_stores writes those documents as they are and run_fixture constructs the coordinator (running the seeded loads) before it freezes the clock at the window start, so the accuracy store's later samples load unbounded against the wall clock; stores loaded later, under the frozen clock, are clamped by the store boundary instead. Either way the replayed coordinator starts holding evidence from after the window, and the window's own new samples append behind it.

evidence.contention_note: box shared with other finder seats; counts are contention-immune

findings.title: The synthetic null bundle never runs the drift latch: observe_bias is called 0 times in 96 cycles
findings.claim: tools/replay/dbg_bundle_gen.py, D15's null control, generates its bundle without ever calling SnapshotRing.observe_bias (0 calls over 96 cycles on --days 2; the 7-day bundle's snapshots store records last_day ''), so D15.M6's latch comparison on the null control reads a clean, never-run latch as agreement: m6_monitor.py --fresh re-derives last_day 2026-01-21 over 7 counted days against a stored ''.
findings.mechanism: The generator drives tests/replay.py:run_fixture, whose FakeHass closes every spawned coroutine but the session restore, so the coordinator's _async_load_snapshots never runs, _snapshots_loaded stays false and _async_watch_learning_drift returns at its first line on every cycle. tools/replay/debug_replay.py already carries the remedy for the timeline replay (enable_store_loads runs the spawned loads), but the generator does not use it, so the null control's drift watch, weekly snapshot and accuracy_drift latch are never exercised and their stored state is the constructor's.

findings.title: Replay judge no_default fires on the optimal-setpoint sensor at the configured max_temperature
findings.claim: On the owner's replay window (hours 7-9) tests/replay.py:inv_no_default reports sensor ...optimal_setpoint=21.0 as a leaked ThermalState default although the value is the action's setpoint clamped at the configured max_temperature (21.0 in the replay entry), because SETPOINT_KEYS exempts only valve_target_recommendation; with the setpoint sensor's keys added to SETPOINT_KEYS the offender count goes 1 -> 0.

findings.title: Replay judge not_frozen reads a config-constant wear price as a frozen mirror of the electricity price
findings.claim: On the owner's replay window (hours 7-9) tests/replay.py:frozen_offenders reports compressor_starts.wear_price_per_start 'stayed 0.3 while sensor.price moved', although wear_price_per_start is replacement_cost / rated_starts (heatpump_optimizer.wear:wear_price_per_start), a constant that never moved in the window; hours 13-15 show the same with solar_heat_gain.orientation_factor 'stayed 0.7' against the price (a configured factor); restricting the judge to published series that moved at least once takes the count 1 -> 0.
findings.mechanism: frozen_offenders takes a published series as a mirror of an input when at least MIRROR_MIN_HITS cycles and half the paired cycles lie within MIRROR_TOL of the input and two distinct non-zero input values matched. A published constant passes all three whenever the input hovers near it for a short window (an 8-cycle chunk, a price near 0.3), and then every later price move reads as the mirror freezing.
findings.instrumented_symbol: tests/replay.py:frozen_offenders over heatpump_optimizer.coordinator's published wear_price_per_start (heatpump_optimizer.wear:wear_price_per_start) in the seeded replay

findings.phenomenon_property: The not_frozen judge flags only a published value that tracked an input and then stopped: a series constant over the whole window is never a mirror.
